SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dist_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) dist_sl, SUM(r.refund_net) refunds
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=6 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1

SELECT s.store_id=900 AS is_web, o.status, COUNT(*) n, SUM(f.net_amount) net, MIN(f.sale_date) mn, MAX(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-11-30'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, cp.category, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) net_sales, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales-n.cost),2) gm, ROUND(100.0*SUM(n.net_sales-n.cost)/SUM(n.net_sales),2) gm_pct
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_period=6 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_week, cp.category, COUNT(*) n, SUM(f.net_amount) net, SUM(f.standard_cost) cost, ROUND(100*(1-SUM(f.standard_cost)/SUM(f.net_amount)),1) gm,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost IS NULL OR f.standard_cost<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) badcost,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos,
 SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(f.standard_cost - f.quantity*p.standard_unit_cost)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) costmismatch,
 SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)-f.gross_amount)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vatmismatch

JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=6 AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') AND s.store_id<>999
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1
